# Asking After Rina, the Town Resident

It looks like Arthur, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.

Description
01 It looks like Arthur, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.
Quest journal 03 ⌄ 02 Arthur, the town clerk, asked me to check on Rina, a resident of the town. Let's go see how Rina is doing.
03 Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
04 I checked on Rina, a resident of Henesys. I'm glad to see she's doing well!
NPC Dialogue
On accept
"I'm curious to know how Rina , one of Henesys's residents, is doing lately. It would be wonderful if you could check on her for me.
- Arthur "
On completion
Oh, aren't you you ? It's so lovely to see you again. What brings you by today?
Ah, so Arthur asked you to check on me. How sweet... I truly believe no one looks after the people of this town as well as Arthur does.
As you can see, I'm doing just fine. Except for the fact that I haven't decided on tonight's dinner menu yet, that is. I hope you have a wonderful day too, you !
